items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: I made a trip with Randy because his brother couldn't go. I made a trip with Randy and we had to leave that morning.

ctx.x: No, I never played with him. I, uh, uh, Who'd he have on clarinet with him then at that time, uh, Sammy? Can you remember?
Yeah. I, I, I can't call this man's name. He used to live downtown and he died too. He used to play with Randy and then he used to play with, uh, Buddy Petit sometime. I can't call his name.
Wasn't there a fella named, Georgie Boy?
